name: meme
description: A real global meme (imgflip template or GIF, fetched at build time by pipeline/memes.py) as a printed photo tossed onto the field, full content width, with optional paper-scrap labels on it and an optional meme sound (myinstants). Cut to it on the word after a punchline. kind image|video (video = silent GIF loop, stepped from a sprite). Pick the exact template with `memes.py search "<q>" --kind <kind>` and set pick. labels: [{text, x, y}] in % of the picture (centre of the scrap). Global memes only — no Indian films/TV/people.
